steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM with username admin and password bench-admin-pass. Then go to the Opportunities list and report the names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen. Do not modify anything.

02-create: Create a new Opportunity in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions or the select dialog, not just type it; note other accounts have similar names so pick the exact one); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500 (default currency); Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions or select dialog, exact match); Description = 'Bench opportunity for run {{runid}}'. Save the record. Then verify by reopening the record and report the values shown for Name, Account, Stage, Amount, Close Date, Assigned User, and Description, plus the record ID from the page address (#Opportunity/view/<id>).
